g.text: Bendigo Hospital is about a 20-minute walk from the Bendigo
Railway Station. Buses run regularly past the hospital, with bus
stops located on Barnard Street and Arnold Street.
Phone: 1300 734 441 for individual public transport options.
Taxis can be booked by calling 131 008. Drop-offs are available
at the main entrance on Mercy Street or the Emergency
Bike racks are located adjacent to both the Mercy Street main
entrance and the Drought Street entrance.
Designated short-term drop-off and pick-up areas are located
at the Mercy Street main entrance and Emergency Department
• On-street parking is available around the hospital precinct
• Disabled parking bays are clearly signed and accessible.
o Basement car park (under the hospital building)
o Multi-storey car park (via link bridge)
• The main public lifts in the CSC are accessed via the
Lucan Street entry and Level F in the multi deck
carpark. When attending appointments at Stewart
Street, it is best to access the campus from the
dedicated Stewart Street entrances, although there
is a pedestrian pathway on Level 2 that links the
Phillips and Hyett buildings. Each entry and
department reception use a number sequence for
identification. You may see something like this -
Stewart Street Entry 2, Reception 3. This means
enter at Stewart Street Entry 2 and approach
Reception 3 for your appointment. There are
wayfinding boards and directional signage at each
Traditional Custodians of the land and
pay our respects to Elders past,
